text.tspan: Mona gives Ahmed an open padlock
and keeps its key. Ahmed puts the
code key in a box, locks it with
يرى سمير الصندوق ولا يستطيع فتحه،
هذه هي الطريقة التي يشرحها الكتاب.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Samir sees the box but cannot open it;
This is the method the book explains.
